statements.statement_text: All cleaning fluids used during titanium processing shall be verified to be compatible before use.
statements.justification: Mercury, cadmium, silver, and gold can cause liquid-metal-induced embrittlement of titanium alloys.

statements.statement_text: Cadmium shall not be used in crew or vacuum environments.
statements.justification: Cadmium is highly toxic, can sublime and cause outgassing contamination at elevated temperatures in vacuum, and can cause liquid metal embrittlement.
